# appzones

> Long-lived sandboxes for desktop apps, dev tools and AI agents on Linux (NixOS). Each zone has its own home, its own network rules (internet yes; host, LAN and tailnets no) and its own window border colour. Zones are declared in one TOML file (`~/.config/appzones/zones.toml`) and run as systemd user units; the `appzones` CLI starts them and runs things inside.

Built from bubblewrap, pasta + nftables, xdg-dbus-proxy and the Wayland security context; no daemon and no setuid binary of its own. Links below are the raw markdown of each docs page. All of them in one file: [llms-full.txt]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/llms-full.txt). Source: https://github.com/mirql/appzones (MIT).
